home.metaDescription: Im Birkenhain: 300 rental apartments on the forest edge in Rudolfstetten-Friedlisberg. 17 building areas, car-free at ground level, pool, bistro and gym.
home.heroTitle: Spacious, sustainable living on the edge of the Isleren forest
home.heroLead: On the Isleren site a quarter of 17 staggered houses is taking shape between the Mutschellen junction and the forest: 300 rental apartments, a square under birches, and not a single car above ground.
home.introP1: Seventeen staggered town houses gather around a generous neighbourhood square, planted with the birch grove that gives the quarter its name. Every home looks into greenery: the forest edge, the courtyards, the planted roof gardens.
home.introP2: Between the forest and the existing village, a quarter with its own identity emerges — dense, but small-grained; ambitious, but quiet.
home.lageTitle: At the end of the road, ten minutes from the train
home.lageBody: Rudolfstetten-Friedlisberg sits on the Mutschellen at 550 m, between the Reuss valley and the Limmat valley. The site is the last one before the Isleren forest — and still inside the well-served centre.
home.teaserLageText: Ten minutes on foot to the S17, the forest right at the door.
home.teaserArchText: Town houses from three to eight storeys, stepped towards the forest.
home.teaserFreiText: The forest continues into the quarter — square, natural pool, play areas.
home.teaserNachText: Green roofs, photovoltaics, rainwater retention, 39 % left unbuilt.
home.servicesTitle: Everyday life, one minute from the front door
home.service1Text: Coffee, lunch, a desk for the home-office day.
home.service2Text: Training rooms in the stone plinth, facing the water.
home.service3Text: Swimming pond with a lawn, north of the square.
home.service4Text: 290 m² with its own outdoor space, for up to three groups.
home.service5Text: Summer party, food trucks, open-air cinema — or simply shade.
home.planungBody: The quarter is being developed on the basis of the «Im Birkenhain» design plan. All documents are public — questions from neighbours are welcome at any time.
home.tl1: Study commission by the municipality, six planning teams
home.tl2: Architecture competition, winning project by SAOTA
home.tl3: Guiding project, revised by Lötscher Architektur
home.tl8: Building application, construction start in stages

architektur.metaDescription: 17 building areas of three to eight full storeys, stepped towards the forest. Beige Eternit façade, dark bronze, stone plinth — materials and phasing.
architektur.title: Seventeen town houses, stepped towards the forest
architektur.lead: The houses do not stand in a row but offset: each has its own address, each leaves its neighbour a view. From eight storeys on the north-west corner they step down towards the forest edge.
architektur.pendingData: Figure pending from the design plan.
architektur.p1: Multi-storey volumes are built together and staggered in height so that density is barely perceptible. Recessed plinths, shifted façades and passages at ground level break the volumes into readable units.
architektur.p2: Compact volumes with punched façades: windows and doors as clearly defined openings in a homogeneous wall. Upper floors cantilever at least 80 cm over the plinth on the main living sides.
architektur.p3: The fifth façade counts too: flat roofs become planted roof gardens wherever no photovoltaics are installed.
architektur.legendD: DINK's — double income, no kids · buildings D
architektur.planNote: Storeys and use per building appear in the panel above. Site plan deltavormgroep, 16 July 2025; building areas per the guiding project of 13 August 2025.
architektur.matLead: White textured plaster, beige Eternit façade panels, bronze and dark-bronze metal — on a plinth in stone or brick-look cladding.

freiraum.metaDescription: A path network like tree roots, the birch grove as signature tree, a square with water feature, seating steps and bistro terrace. Design deltavormgroep.
freiraum.title: The forest continues into the quarter
freiraum.lead: What lies between the houses is not leftover space but a continuous landscape: paths branch like roots, differences in level are taken up by planted walls, and at the centre stands the birch grove.
freiraum.p1: The landscape design continues the layering of the forest: large trees, shrubs, herbaceous and ground layers. That is the contrast to the architecture — and what makes the courtyards feel cool in summer.
freiraum.p2: Along the forest edge, meeting points and play areas for different ages: a volleyball court, a forest playground, a bootcamp, a boccia lane. Two further playgrounds sit inside the quarter.
freiraum.stat2Label: planted flat roofs wherever no photovoltaics are installed
freiraum.stat3Label: the signature group of trees at the centre of the square
freiraum.wegTitle: Like the roots of a tree
freiraum.wegP1: The paths branch from the forest edge down through the quarter and out to the surrounding neighbourhoods — wide where people meet, narrow where they simply pass. Nothing ends in a dead end.
freiraum.wegP2: And where the paths meet, a signature tree marks the difference: the vegetation of the quarter is read as its own layer, distinct from the forest around it.
freiraum.baumTitle: White trunks against the dark forest
freiraum.baumBody: The birch is the tree that tells the quarter apart from the woodland behind it: pale trunks, a light canopy, moving shade. Planted as a grove on the square and as a gateway at the Alpenweg entrance, it turns the name into something you can see.
freiraum.baumAlt: Birch grove as a reference image
freiraum.f1Text: The central meeting place, usable in every season: summer party, food trucks, open-air cinema.
freiraum.f2Text: A swimming pond with a lawn north of the square, next to the gym in the stone plinth.
freiraum.f3Text: Differences in level are taken up by stepped walls that are planted over.
freiraum.platzCredit: Landscape design deltavormgroep · not to scale
freiraum.platzBody: A paved wedge under the birches: seating steps towards the west, the water feature at its centre, the bistro terrace on the sunny east edge.
freiraum.platzAlt: Detail plan of the neighbourhood square
freiraum.winterCaption: The square works in every season — the birch grove keeps its structure in winter.

lage.metaDescription: At the Mutschellen junction: the S17 every 15 minutes, Zurich HB in 31 minutes, two stops within a ten-minute walk. Car-free above ground, garage below.
lage.title: Between the Mutschellen junction and the forest
lage.lead: Well connected and yet at the end of the road. Cars go underground right at the entrance to the site; above ground the quarter stays car-free — open only to deliveries, emergency vehicles and moving days.
lage.p1: The site lies on the edge of the Mutschellen junction — well connected, yet at the end of the road. The S17 runs every 15 minutes to Dietikon and on to Zürich; two stops are within ten minutes on foot.
lage.p2: Cars go underground right at the entrance to the site; above ground the estate stays car-free, with access only for deliveries, emergency vehicles and moving days.
lage.mapCaption: Islerenstrasse, 8964 Rudolfstetten-Friedlisberg · 550 m above sea level
lage.veloLead: Above ground the estate is car-free — and the centre stays free of bicycle traffic too. Bikes are parked at the edge of the development and in the basement.
lage.veloCaption: Schematic of cycling and walking: a traffic-free centre, covered bike stands at the edge, bike rooms below ground. A sketch of the principle, not a plan.
lage.veloAlt: Schematic section through the site: above, the traffic-free centre with trees and people on foot; covered bike stands under a canopy at the edges; below, the basement with bike parking, trailers, lockable cabinets and a charging point.
lage.v1Text: The centre stays free of cars and bicycles. The paths inside belong to people on foot.
lage.v2Text: Enough covered bike parking is planned along the edge of the development — close to the entrances and out of the weather.
lage.v3Text: Generous bike parking is planned below ground, with space for trailers.
lage.v4Text: E-bike spaces are planned with a power supply, plus lockable cabinets for helmet, charger and the like.

nachhaltigkeit.metaDescription: A ground-source heat pump with 22,000 m of probes, 2,900 m2 of photovoltaics, battery storage, free cooling and on-site retention — the energy concept.
nachhaltigkeit.title: Density where the infrastructure already is
nachhaltigkeit.lead: Instead of new building land at the edges, the quarter uses a key site inside the existing settlement, ten minutes from the railway. That is the most effective sustainability measure in the whole project.
nachhaltigkeit.p1: Instead of new building land at the edges, the quarter uses a key site inside the existing settlement, ten minutes from the railway. That is the most effective sustainability measure in the whole project.
nachhaltigkeit.p2: An energy concept secures the supply: photovoltaics on the roofs, extensive green roofs, rainwater retention and infiltration on site, ecological compensation areas, and buildings aligned with the cold-air corridors.
nachhaltigkeit.s1Label: maximum built over or under ground — 61 % in the guiding project
nachhaltigkeit.s2Label: on every flat roof not used for photovoltaics or terraces
nachhaltigkeit.s3Label: residential density on a key inner-development site
nachhaltigkeit.s4Label: surface water stays on site — infiltration and planted layers
nachhaltigkeit.energieCredit: Energy concept Real North AG, 15 July 2025
nachhaltigkeit.e1Text: Heating and hot water come from boreholes — around 22,000 m of probes for an estimated demand of 1,000 kW. In summer the same field cools the flats passively through the underfloor circuit (freecooling).
nachhaltigkeit.e2Text: Each building has its own inverter. Solar power serves heating, cooling and hot water first; the surplus goes to residents through a ZEV self-consumption group or into the grid.
nachhaltigkeit.e3Text: A central battery room is planned to raise self-consumption, flatten peak loads and stabilise the local grid — subject to proven economic viability.
nachhaltigkeit.e4Text: Built to Minergie level without certification: heavy insulation, triple glazing, an airtight envelope, underfloor heating with room-by-room control — 21 °C living, 23 °C bathrooms.
nachhaltigkeit.rejected1: Wood-chip heating — the forest is next door, but winter demand would mean a delivery every four to six days: too much grey energy and noise.
nachhaltigkeit.rejected2: District heating — AEW is extending its network in Rudolfstetten, but neither costs nor connection date are fixed, so it is not pursued for now.
nachhaltigkeit.rejected3: Air-source heat pumps — lower efficiency at low temperatures, more noise, more space; ground probes win the comparison.
nachhaltigkeit.flat1: Windows that open: no mechanical ventilation system in the flats, only enclosed rooms are extracted mechanically.
nachhaltigkeit.flat2: Kitchens with recirculation hoods and activated-carbon filters.
nachhaltigkeit.flat3: The natural pool stays unheated; whether it can act as a buffer in the energy system is being examined.
nachhaltigkeit.flat4: Charging points in the garage, prepared for expansion, with load management to prevent overloads.
nachhaltigkeit.bandCaption: The fifth façade: photovoltaics where the sun is best, extensive planting everywhere else.
nachhaltigkeit.bandAlt: Flat roofs with photovoltaics and planting

wohnungen.metaDescription: 300 rental apartments from 2.5 to 5.5 rooms for DINKs, families and best agers. Layouts provisional; rents and letting start follow later.
wohnungen.title: 300 apartments to rent, 2.5 to 5.5 rooms
wohnungen.lead: All apartments are for rent — none are for sale. The mix runs from the 2.5-room flat to the 5.5-room family apartment, with the three-and-a-half and four-and-a-half-room flats forming the core. Layouts and areas are provisional; rents and the letting schedule follow later.
wohnungen.spiegelPending: The apartment overview will be published as soon as the apartment data is available.
wohnungen.bandCaption: Living, dining and kitchen in one room, with the loggia to the west. Visualisation, non-binding.
wohnungen.bandAlt: Living, dining and kitchen in a 4.5-room apartment
wohnungen.typenCredit: Areas provisional, per the guiding project
wohnungen.t25Text: For singles and couples: one living room with an open kitchen, a bedroom, bathroom and store.
wohnungen.t35Text: Two bedrooms, bathroom and an entrance with a store — the most common type in the quarter.
wohnungen.t45Text: Three bedrooms, two wet rooms, a living room with a kitchen island facing the balcony.
wohnungen.t55Text: Four bedrooms for families; on the top floors with a roof terrace.
wohnungen.zgTitle: Built for three ways of living
wohnungen.zgCredit: The building code carries the target group
wohnungen.zgIntro: The apartments are laid out for three groups of residents, and each building is assigned to one of them — the letter in the building code says which.
wohnungen.zgDText: Compact, well-cut flats for couples who are out a lot: open living rooms, a generous loggia, the bistro and the gym a minute away.
wohnungen.zgFText: The larger 4.5 and 5.5-room flats, close to the day-care, the playgrounds and the square — and the whole estate is car-free above ground.
wohnungen.zgBText: Step-free flats in the lower row houses along Obere Dorfstrasse: shops within walking distance, the forest at the door, quiet.
wohnungen.innenAlt: Kitchen with island and built-in cabinet wall
wohnungen.innen1: Oak floors in the living rooms, hard-wearing surfaces in the cooking zone.
wohnungen.innen2: Underfloor heating with room-by-room control — 21 °C living, 23 °C bathrooms — and passive cooling through the same circuit in summer.
wohnungen.innen3: Triple glazing and deep window reveals in the punched façade; windows that open, no mechanical ventilation.
wohnungen.innen4: Balconies at least 80 cm deep on the main living side; a roof terrace on the top floors.

datenschutz.metaDescription: How the Im Birkenhain project website handles personal data: registration form, double opt-in, map, no cookies.
datenschutz.title: Privacy
datenschutz.reviewNote: Draft, written from the actual technical implementation. To be reviewed by legal counsel and completed with the controller's details before the site is released.
datenschutz.controllerBody: Real North AG as the client of the Im Birkenhain project.
datenschutz.controllerPending: To be added: address and an email address for data subjects to contact.
datenschutz.dataBody: Only what you enter in the registration form yourself: first name, last name and email address are required; phone number, preferred number of rooms, move-in date and notes are optional. No personal data is collected if you do not register.
datenschutz.purposeBody: The details are used solely to add you to the registration list and to contact you when letting begins. No profiling and no automated individual decision-making takes place.
datenschutz.consentBody: After submitting you receive an email with a confirmation link. Your registration is stored only once you click it. The link is valid for seven days and can be used once. If you do not confirm, the unconfirmed registration is deleted automatically and completely after seven days.
datenschutz.retentionBody: Confirmed registrations are kept until initial letting is complete and are deleted afterwards. You may request deletion at any time; registering again remains possible.
datenschutz.securityBody: The data is held on the hosting provider's web server in a file outside the publicly accessible area. Your email address is additionally stored as a check value (HMAC) so that duplicate registrations can be detected without keeping the address as a plaintext lookup key. The confirmation link does not contain your email address.
datenschutz.abuseBody: To prevent automated mass registrations, the number of attempts per IP address and per email address is counted for at most one hour. The IP address is used only as a counter, is not linked to your registration, and is deleted once the hour has passed.
datenschutz.processorsBody: No data is disclosed for advertising purposes and no data is sold. The hosting provider's mail server is used to send the confirmation email and acts as a processor in that respect.
datenschutz.processorsPending: To be added: name and domicile of the hosting provider.
datenschutz.mapBody: The map on «Location & mobility» loads map tiles from OpenStreetMap. It loads automatically with the page; this transmits your IP address to OpenStreetMap. No cookies are set for this, and nothing is stored in your browser.
datenschutz.cookiesBody: This website sets no cookies, uses no analytics or tracking tools and embeds no advertising networks. Fonts are served from our own domain, not by a third party. The web server logs access technically, as is usual with any web hosting.
datenschutz.cookiesPending: To be added: retention period of the hosting provider's server access logs.
datenschutz.rightsBody: You have the right to information about the data processed about you, to rectification, to erasure and to data portability. An email to the address above is sufficient. You may also contact the Swiss Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC).
